data.name: Ehan
data.gender_notes: Ehan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Ehan translates to 'He who rules', or 'The ruler'. This name is derived from the root word 'Eha' meaning 'he' and 'Han' meaning 'ruler' or 'lord'. In Hindu mythology, Ehan is a name of various deities, representing power, strength, and leadership. The name Ehan carries the meaning “Ruler, Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ehan usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Ehan carries deep spiritual significance in Hinduism. It represents the journey of the soul towards enlightenment and the infinite possibilities that lie within. It is a reminder that no matter how far we may feel from our goals or our true selves, we are never truly alone and are always connected to the divine.
